 HONOR Philippines announces 11.11 Early Mega Christmas Sale
 Available now until November 13, featuring big deals on an array of devices.
 By Nicolo Manaloto - November 4, 2026 HONOR Philippines recently kicked off its 11.11 Early Mega Christmas Sale on Lazada, Shopee, and TikTok Shop. While it’s an 11.11 sale, it won’t just be available on November 11, as the sale period is live now until November 13.
 The HONOR devices that are part of the sale include HONOR Play 10, HONOR Play 20A, HONOR Pad X7b, HONOR Pad X9b Max, HONOR 600S, HONOR Magic V6, HONOR Choice Earbuds Clip, HONOR Watch 6, and HONOR Choice Pencil.
 Fittingly, the sale features 11-themed deals including a PHP 1,111 discount on the already affordable HONOR Play 10. This offer will be available exclusively on Lazada. Along with this highlight offer, there will be up to PHP 30,000 in discounts on select HONOR devices, alongside exclusive freebies.
 For instance, HONOR has up to 24 months of 0% interest installment promo for the HONOR Magic V6 via participating bank credit cards. There will also be a special Shopee offer where fans can watch the CEO’s New Jowa (HONOR’s vertical drama made in partnership with Viva) and get a chance to win an HONOR 600S. The HONOR Play 20A will also arrive soon with some special deals.
 As for TikTok Shop, buyers will get early access to the HONOR Pad X7b, with discounts of up to PHP 2,000. There will also be special freebies with select devices, including the HONOR 600S and HONOR Pad X9b Max.
 Finally, there are Buy Now, Pay Later via SPayLater, LazPayLater, and TikTok PayLater on select HONOR devices, with some purchases featuring up to six months of 0% interest payment plans.
 You can get the HONOR 11.11 Early Mega Christmas Sale deals now until November 13 on Lazada , Shopee , and TikTok Shop .
 Honor Honor Philippines Nicolo Manaloto
 UnGeek's resident editor who is obsessed with anything and everything Death Stranding. He is also a big fan of the Yakuza series, and is a weaboo in denial.
